fields.value: Senior Business Analyst – Liquidity | Treasury | LCR/NSFR | Regulatory Reporting

citations.quote: Senior Business Analyst – Liquidity | Treasury | LCR/NSFR | Regulatory

fields.value: 14 years of experience in IT, with extensive experience as a Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager across Banking, Risk, Treasury, Liquidity and Regulatory Reporting. Strong experience in Liquidity Risk and Treasury, covering LCR, NSFR, Intraday Liquidity, liquidity forecasting, cash-flow analysis, liquidity monitoring and regulatory reporting within banking environments. Experienced in analysing intraday cash positions, cash inflows/outflows, funding requirements and liquidity positions, supporting liquidity monitoring, forecasting and reporting processes. Hands-on experience in liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis, including assessment of liquidity positions, cash-flow impacts, funding requirements and potential shortfalls under different business scenarios. Experienced in translating requirements from Treasury, Risk, Finance and IT into BRDs, FSDs, functional specifications, process flows, data-mapping documents, user stories and test scenarios. Strong experience in source-to-target data mapping, data lineage, data validation, data reconciliation, data analysis and regulatory reporting, including supporting data/system migration and implementation initiatives. Experienced in coordinating SIT/UAT, migration testing, defect management, stakeholder sign-offs, implementation, training and post-implementation support across banking and regulatory platforms.
